method.purpose: Provisional AI-assisted Scripture alignment layer for the 94 highest-precision findings with three proper-named stars.
safeguards: NO_MATCH is allowed and used when the three HR meanings do not form a natural biblical unit.
Reverse/permuted chains share an independenceGroup so they are not counted as independent confirmations.
Star-name etymologies are not inferred in this pass; each remains unverified until philological source checking.
Theological matching is kept separate from astronomical geometry.
Scores are provisional triage scores, not statistical probabilities.
method.scoreScale: 1-5; forcedness is inverse (1 = little forcing, 5 = highly forced).
